notes.title: Antioma Demo — Release Patch
notes.notes: [p]Antioma launches in just two days, and we're rolling out a major update to the demo! It now fully represents the final quality of the game, complete with new music, characters' voices, and professional translations.[/p][p align="start"]Help Kiddo escape from the hospital on his Birthday![/p][p align="start"][b]A note for players who are getting the full version:[/b] To avoid potential issues with transferring your save data (we've tested everything, but we can't rule out all risks), we advise you to either:[/p][list][*][p]Wait two days and start fresh with the full version.[/p][/*][*][p]Or start a new game after the full version is out.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]If you're feeling adventurous, you can always try to transfer your save, we did our best to make it work! :)[/p][p align="start"]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added 5 new music tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]All characters now have voices, and the most important cutscenes feature complete voice acting.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization: All translations have been done manually and now match the languages available in the full game.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]See you on September 10th![/b][/p]

notes.title: Antioma will be released in a week!
notes.notes: [p]Well, just one week left until release, and everything is finally ready. No more delays — the game will launch on September 10th. But before release, there are a few important things we want to share so you’ll be fully prepared for what awaits you in Antioma.[/p][h1]About Voice Acting[/h1][p]After those awesome trailers (thanks to the Команда Шаттла 311-Х), some of you might be expecting full voice acting in the game, so let’s clarify. Antioma turned out to be quite large, and we couldn’t afford to fully voice it. However, the most emotional and important moments are voiced. And the rest of the dialogues aren’t completely silent either — most characters have unique voices, expressed through emotional reactions and exclamations. This wouldn’t have been possible without Команда Шаттла 311-Х and the actors who agreed to work on the project for free. Huge thanks to them — we’ll make sure to credit and thank everyone at the release.[/p][h1]About Game Length[/h1][p]When we released the demo, we feared a blind playthrough would only take about 20 minutes. We were wrong — in a good way! The median playtime for the demo was 40 minutes. Based on these estimates, a full playthrough of Antioma should take around 4–6 hours, depending on how quickly you solve the puzzles (and yes, there are places to get stuck). But don’t forget — the game has multiple endings, which might inspire you to play through it a couple more times :)[/p][h1]About Bugs[/h1][p]We worked really hard to track down every possible issue, down to the smallest details, and we’ve logged around 300–400 hours of playtime ourselves (we lost count at some point). Still, there’s always something that’s hard to notice when testing inside the team. That’s why the release version of Antioma will include a “Report a Bug” button in the settings, so you can let us know if you encounter anything. We’re especially interested in hearing about critical issues that block progress (though hopefully there won’t be any).[/p][h1]About Reviews and Support[/h1][p]On release day, we’ll need your help. Steam promotes games more actively once they reach 10 reviews. So here’s our request: play the game, enjoy it, and then write a short review (ideally after spending at least 2 hours in the game). We really hope you’ll like what we’ve prepared (there are plenty of surprises), and we’d be super grateful if you share your thoughts in a review.[/p][p]That’s all we wanted to share. See you on September 10th![/p]

notes.title: New release date for Antioma
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! We have some very important news.[/p][p]Unfortunately, we won’t be able to release Antioma on August 14th as originally planned. An unexpected delay has occurred, and we need a bit more time to polish the game. [/p][p]The new release date is [u]September 10th (7:00 am PDT, 3:00 pm CET)[/u], and we’re fully confident in it. In fact, we expect to finish work well before that deadline. The game is already fully playable, but we just need to bring a few aspects up to the proper quality.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support!
[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and the first patch for Antioma Demo!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve rolled out the first patch for the Antioma demo! In preparation for Steam Next Fest, we’ve polished and expanded the game so returning players can enjoy a bit more content, while newcomers get an even smoother experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]- Added a cutscene at the end of the demo[/p][p]- Added a bit of music[/p][p]- Added localization for 4 more languages[/p][p]- Added credits[/p][p]- Added a dedicated error-reporting option[/p][p]- Added/updated several sound effects[/p][p]- Added achievements (try getting them all!)[/p][p]- Minor fixes[/p][p]The update is already available for download — jump back in and check it out![/p]

notes.title: Antioma — Story Trailer. Demo Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4NDGtD0MILY;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re excited to present the new story trailer for Antioma! It dives deeper into the story of Kiddo, revealing how he ended up in the hospital—and how he plans to escape on his seventh birthday. On this day, the young boy sets out to explore the world beyond the hospital walls for the very first time.

Alongside the trailer, we’re releasing a demo, which is available for download now. Step into Kiddo’s shoes, attempt the escape, and discover how his journey begins.

The demo includes a feedback form — we’d love to hear your thoughts! Your input will help us improve the full version of the game. Enjoy your playthrough!
